title: The order of the window's lists
description: Woodcore-Datei/lists.json -- the order the engineer gives the lists of the window's tabs by drag and drop, and the folders of the «Formules» tab (calc/list_order.py, issue #15, docs/ui/window.md §10quater). Written by Woodcore at each drop, beside the sources the engineer draws; the window's alone -- the report prints by id and the export never reads it. A tab keeps `groups` only where its sources have no `group` field of their own (list_order.GROUPED_TABS, today tab_formula).

tabs.description: One entry per tab, keyed by the tab's key (tab_schema, tab_formula…).

order.description: The ids of the tab's list in the order the engineer gave them; an id not named comes after, by id.

groups.description: The folder of each id, for a tab whose sources cannot carry one (tab_formula): id -> folder name; an id not named is at the root.
